ops.body: WorkshopUpload publishes and updates Oxygen Not Included mods on the Steam Workshop as legacy single-file items, and inspects items. The game has no Workshop depot and downloads only items published through the old `ISteamRemoteStorage` API, so this .NET 8 console app over Steamworks.NET publishes and updates through that API only; an item updated through `ISteamUGC` stops being downloadable by the game. It runs as Klei's Oxygen Not Included Uploader (app 636750, chosen by `steam_appid.txt`) with the game (app 457140) as the consumer app, and needs the Steam client running and logged in as the item's owner. `download` runs as the game (457140) through the `SteamAppId` and `SteamGameId` environment variables, which `tools/ModTest/Test-OniMods.ps1` sets. Its commands are `info`, `description`, `list`, `update`, `publish`, `cloud` and `download`. `tools/Release/release.py` calls it to push a release zip, preview, description and change note to a mod's Workshop item, and `tools/ModTest/Test-OniMods.ps1` uses `download` to fetch a newly subscribed item for `-Steam`.
